projects.title: Cambridge housing development dashboard
projects.description: Cambridge presented a public dashboard to the City Council on October 20 that tracks nearly 250 housing projects at various stages, drawing on data from several city departments and covering projects that add or remove units.
projects.why_interesting: Built to follow the effects of a major zoning reform, it is a model for a pipeline tracker that shows what is permitted, approved and built after a rezoning.

projects.title: A City That Works: Chicago housing dashboard
projects.description: A nonprofit news outlet published an interactive Chicago housing dashboard on October 22 that combines city building permits, Department of Housing maps, Zillow listings and Census data.
projects.why_interesting: A newsroom-built dashboard that joins permit, listing and Census data, a template New York outlets could copy with DOB and ACS data.

projects.title: New York State seasonal respiratory virus dashboard
projects.description: The state Department of Health opened its seasonal dashboard tracking flu, COVID-19 and RSV cases and hospitalizations by location and over time, as flu activity rises.
projects.why_interesting: Weekly state data with geographic detail that can be compared against city health department surveillance reports.

projects.title: NAACP voter tool puts data centers on the ballot
projects.description: A new NAACP tool maps data centers near Black neighborhoods, counting 1,728 already online and 1,042 more proposed, approved or under construction, and shows candidates' positions.
projects.why_interesting: Pairs a national facility inventory with election information, a way to localize data center siting for voters.

projects.title: North Myrtle Beach police calls-for-service map
projects.description: The police department launched a map of daily calls for service that refreshes each morning at 5 a.m. with the prior 24 hours, with locations shown by block number to protect privacy.
projects.why_interesting: A small-department example of a next-day public call map with a privacy rule built in.

projects.title: Hackney Nights map
projects.description: A London borough's night-time map shows accredited venues with opening hours and wheelchair access, plus toilets, drinking water and phone charging points, reached through QR codes in venue windows.
projects.why_interesting: Treats after-dark public amenities as map data. Coverage differs on whether the map is fully live, so check before relying on it.
